messages:
maria: Quick docs PR question — found inconsistent examples for the embeddings batch endpoint. In the public guide and some quickstarts we show a top-level array: `[{\"input\": \"...\"}, ...]` but the OpenAPI and our server actually expect an object: `{ \"inputs\": [\"...\"] }`. I flagged this in docs PR #2345. :confused:

santiago: saw that too earlier today. Which SDK snippets are out of sync? JS, Python, and the curl examples?

kevin: both JS and Python snippets are off. Historically we accepted the array form for backwards compat, but the runtime team standardized on `{inputs: [...]}` last quarter and we never fully propagated docs.

amy: I can prep a tiny PR to standardize examples on the object shape (`{\"inputs\": [...]}`). Will update the OpenAPI example, the quickstart snippets, and the curl sample. Any objections to treating the array example as deprecated in a migration note?

jen: quick note — add a brief migration snippet showing `old array -> new object` so integrators can update. e.g. `POST /embeddings -d '[\"a\",\"b\"]'` becomes `POST /embeddings -d '{\"inputs\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}'`.

docs-bot: PR #2345 created by amy (draft) and linked to issue #512. Added checklist: update OpenAPI, update JS/Python SDK snippets, add migration note.

maria: also found a separate mismatch in the response examples: some pages show `data: [ {embedding: [...] } ]` while our new response shape is `{\"embeddings\": [[...],[...]], \"model\": \"...\", \"usage\": {...} }`. We should pick one canonical example.

kevin: current server response (staging) looks like this:

```
{
  \"request_id\": \"abc-123\",
  \"embeddings\": [
    [0.012, -0.231, ...],
    [0.211, 0.004, ...]
  ],
  \"model\": \"text-embedding-3-small\",
  \"usage\": {\"input_tokens\": 120}
}
```

amy: perfect, I'll update the docs to use that JSON blob and convert the previous `data`-style examples. I'll add a short blurb: "Former example using `data` is legacy; current response places vectors under `embeddings`."

santiago: tagging @kevin for SDK integration changes (parsing path) and @maria for QA smoke tests against staging once the docs deploy.

kevin: got it — I'll update the JS client parsing and the Python helper to read `resp.embeddings`. Will add a unit test to validate both shapes (legacy array and new object) just in case.

maria: I will run a quick end-to-end test after the PR merges. If staging returns the `embeddings` key correctly, we can flip the examples in the site build. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #2345 merged to main (auto-deploy scheduled for docs site). Migration note added under /docs/migrations/embedding-api.md.

maria: thanks all — looks good. Closing this thread; please ping if the smoke test shows anything off. :wave:
